summary: Builds a full bitmap path from a base directory (dword_5EC408, or byte_5EA438 when unset) plus a filename argument a2, validates the path with ConditionalFieldClear, then allocates and appends a 12-byte registry node into a singly-linked list owned by the loader object (head at 0xF0, tail at 0xF4, cursor at 0xF8, count at 0xFC). Returns 0 on path validation failure, 1 on success. Called by sub_4920B0.

local_names.a2: filename argument appended to the base directory
local_names.v8: stack buffer holding the formatted full path
local_names.v7: out handle/holder produced by ConditionalFieldClear path validation
local_names.v4: PathRegistry object pointer returned by StructInitPathRegistry

operations.description: Choose base directory: dword_5EC408 if non-null, else byte_5EA438. Format full path into v8 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v8, "%s%s", base, a2); the packet flags 0x005BE860 (aSS) as the read-only format-string storage.
If ConditionalFieldClear(v8, &v7) returns non-zero the constructed path is invalid and the function returns 0 immediately.
Allocate the PathRegistry object: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12); on success v4 = StructInitPathRegistry(a2, v7), otherwise v4 = 0.
Only proceed with the list insert when the PathRegistry object v4 was allocated successfully.
Allocate a 12-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12); on success initialize node+0 = v4 (registry pointer), node+4 = 0 (next), node+8 = 1 (alive flag), else node = 0.

Append node to the singly-linked list: if head at 0xF0 is non-null set old tail's next (*(this[61]+4)) = node; else set head (0xF0) and cursor (0xF8) to node. Set tail (0xF4) = node and increment the count field at 0xFC.
Return 1 on successful registration; return 0 only on the path-validation failure path.
Invoked by sub_4920B0 (004920B0) to register a bitmap path into the loader's list.
